intent: Make Android remote requests surface screen-share consent when possible, preserve approved MediaProjection through session cleanup, and deploy Hosting without an uninitialized Firebase Storage service.

requestReview.reason: The fix changes only Android local activity, projection, and session lifecycle handling. It adds no Firebase request, timer, listener, retry, polling, or persistence write.

rollback: Revert the Android Agent consent and session-lifecycle commit or the Firebase deploy target change; registered devices and server data remain unchanged.

outcomes.acceptance: When a Viewer requests an Android Agent without active screen sharing, the Agent immediately opens Android's consent flow while its activity or enabled accessibility control service can launch UI; otherwise it posts one high-priority approval notification without using restricted full-screen-intent privileges.
boundaries: Agent or Control Add-On accessibility service
visible Agent activity or background notification
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-05: `npx vitest run src/desktopPackaging.test.ts -t "requests Android screen-share consent only after an explicit Viewer request"` passed 1/1. `gradlew :agent:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.wonremote.agent.AgentProjectionRequestTest :controladdon:compileDebugJavaWithJavac --build-cache` passed all 4 focused lifecycle tests and compiled Agent, Control Add-On, and shared accessibility code.
outcomes.physicalGap: Android background launch through the enabled Agent or Control Add-On accessibility service, system consent, and notification fallback still require a physical device check.

outcomes.acceptance: A stale stop command, a late callback from an older session, or closure of the active remote session cannot turn off the Android screen-sharing indicator; only the explicit local screen-share stop or Agent exit ends MediaProjection.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-05: The focused Android JUnit class passed 4/4, covering current-session stop matching, stale callback rejection, and consent fallback. The packaging contract passed 1/1 and pins projection-preserving cancel, stop-command, and session-close paths.
outcomes.physicalGap: The Android red screen-sharing indicator and first remote frame require physical verification.

outcomes.acceptance: The normal deployment command publishes Viewer and Android ZIP Hosting content without failing when Firebase Storage has not been initialized; Storage rules deploy only when explicitly requested after Storage setup.
outcomes.physicalGap: Live Firebase Hosting download route verification is pending deployment.
